bio: After a hiatus, Portugália has reopened in the historic town with the same kitchen and service teams. The blue-and-white interior, dotted in matching azulejo tiles from their previous address, is relaxed and cosy. The menu features authentic Portuguese family favourites in sharing portions, such as gambas a la guillo, and the signature steak ‘a Portugália’ in a secret gravy. Round off the meal with a fluffy, whipped serradura....
